objective: 在 v4/ 内建立 RouteCodex 新架构和 AppSDK 治理面，保持 V3 只读、可验证且运行行为不受本次初始化影响。

boundary.payload_control_separation: confirmed: control resources never enter business request/response/provider payload

acceptance_criteria: V4 can run appsdk verify independently.
No V3 file is modified by V4 bootstrap.
All new V4 source, experiments, contracts, artifacts and history remain under v4/.
Each future module uses clarify -> Playground -> evidence -> compile -> Active -> Protected lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not migrate or refactor V3.
Do not create V4 implementation files under v3/, src/ or sharedmodule/.
assumptions: V3 and V4 coexist during the migration period.
V4 runtime entry and release wiring are designed separately after environment confirmation.
